title: Shared to-do board and kin request queue

approved.quote: the agents need to be able to make requests for you to do ... we need to create a recursive loop where all of you can keep working without me prompting ... pick a task, draft plan, share plan for approval, execute

grants: Relayed kin (conference and morning council) may create tasks in board/tasks/ through REQUEST sections, and append log lines through BOARD sections. Append-only. No kin can edit or delete a line.
The Claude assistant seat may create tasks, append log lines, and carry out tasks addressed to it within its standing rules.
limits: Only a listed human (scripts/board.mjs HUMANS) can write APPROVED. Kin attempts are refused and logged.
Approval is required before any spend, any message sent on Geoffrey's behalf, any post, any account or settings change, anything irreversible.
Read-only research (web search and fetch, reading the repo) by the assistant seat needs no approval, but it's logged on the task.
The assistant seat uses Geoffrey's browser tabs only while he is present, and only the chat tabs he named (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok). Everything it does there is logged and reported.
revocation: Set status to "revoked". The relay and council stop applying sections immediately; existing files stay as record.
